name: free-habit-tracker-no-streak-guilt
description: Free browser habit tracker that forgives missed days — no streak resets to zero, no guilt, ADHD-friendly. No signup, 100% private. A free tool by BeMooore.

paragraphs: A free, private, no-signup habit tracker that forgives your missed days. One bad day never resets your progress to zero, there's no red X of shame, and it's built for brains that don't run on perfect chains (hi, ADHD). Everything is stored locally in your browser — nothing is ever uploaded.

Most habit apps are built on punishment: string together a streak, miss one day, watch the counter reset to 0 in red, then avoid the app out of guilt. That's not a willpower problem — it's a design problem. The missed day is the most useful moment there is (it tells you what gets in your way), so this tool keeps your progress visible after a slip and makes coming back feel easy instead of shameful.
